source: 刘晓燕《四级你还在背单词吗》
title: The Night the Ferry Lost Power
title_cn: 渡轮失去动力的那一夜
tts_text: The ferry Green Bay leaves the harbour at ten every night. Its crew is small: a captain, an engineer, four sailors. The captain's colleague and the staff in the office on shore keep the radio on all night. That night an old fellow with a dog came aboard. His stuff slid across the deck when the sea turned rough. At midnight the engine made a sound that resembled a hammer on metal. One loose screw had fallen out of the pump. In his haste the engineer grabbed the wrong tool. He had always despised that pump and looked at it with contempt. The captain urged the passengers to stay in their seats. With great caution he turned toward the nearest island, aware that the wind would rise. He had taken one precaution: the tanks were full. On deck the crew stayed alert and conscious of the cold. Then the lights went out and the passengers felt real terror. A little girl was terrified by the black water and turned pale. Her mother held her tighter and stared in horror. It was a dreadful night. The old fellow wanted to rebel, but his conscience held him in his seat. The warm cabin tempted the sleepy passengers, yet nobody slept. A warning on the engine-room door read paim, where the painter had meant palm. The engineer made one last attempt, but it was in vain. Then the captain found a red triangle on the map, marking a small calm bay. By three o'clock both engines worked in harmony. The hatred on the young sailor's face turned into a smile. In the morning the staff on shore counted everyone twice.

sentences_cn: 渡轮「绿湾号」每晚十点驶离港口。
船上的船员不多：一名船长、一名轮机长，四个水手。
船长的同事和岸上办公室的员工整夜不关无线电。
那天夜里，一位带着狗的老头上船了。
海面转糟时，他的行李在甲板上滑来滑去。
午夜时分，发动机发出了一种像锤子敲在金属上的声音。
一颗松动的螺丝从水泵上掉了下来。
轮机长一着急，抓错了工具。
他一直看不上那台水泵，此刻更是带着蔑视盯着它。
船长催所有乘客坐回自己的座位。
他万分谨慎地把船头转向最近的岛，同时意识到一点以后风会变大。
他提前做过一项预防措施：油箱是满的。
甲板上，船员们保持警觉，也清楚地感到寒冷。
接着灯灭了，乘客们感到了真正的恐惧。
一个小女孩被漆黑的海水吓坏了，脸色变得苍白。
她母亲把她搂得更紧，惊恐地盯着海面。
那是个可怕的夜晚。
那位老头想要反抗，但良心把他按在了座位上。
温暖的船舱诱惑着困倦的乘客，可谁也没睡。
轮机舱的门上有一行手写的警告，写的是 paim，写字的人本想写 palm。
轮机长做了最后一次尝试，但徒劳无功。
这时船长在地图上找到一个红色的三角形，那是一个小小的平静海湾。
到三点钟，两台发动机协调地一起运转起来。
年轻水手脸上的憎恨慢慢变成了笑容。
早上，岸上的员工把人数点了两遍。
